args.message: Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money`, contradicting both its own docstring and FIN-212, which requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build failure (`tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` failed on `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Change
- Replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed (tests including `test_half_even`).

function.name: commit_changes

transcript.reasoning_content:
Note: Decimal("2.675") with ROUND_HALF_EVEN: 2.675 in exact decimal is 2.675, which is a tie between 2.67 and 2.68. ROUND_HALF_EVEN would round to 2.68 (since 2.67 has odd last digit 7... wait, half-even rounds to even last digit: 2.67 vs 2.68 — 8 is even, so rounds to 2.68). Yes, correct. And 2.665: 2.66 (6 even) vs 2.67 — rounds to 2.66. Correct.

Run CI.
